[[File:Starwarsccg-palace.decipher.com 22 December 1997.jpg|thumb|starwarsccg-palace.decipher.com, 22 December 1997.]]
'''starwarsccg-palace.decipher.com''' was a [[Decipher.com]] host. The Palace chat world used <code>palace://starwarsccg-palace.decipher.com</code>. See [[Star Wars CCG Palace]]. The host's web root served The Eccentric Order, Decipher's ordering site for the ''Star Trek CCG'' Fajo Collection.<ref name="ecc">[http://starwarsccg-palace.decipher.com/ Welcome To The Eccentric Order!], Decipher (December 1997). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19971222045757/http://starwarsccg-palace.decipher.com/ Internet Archive]</ref>
